shortDescription: Creates Server Maintenance Policy on Cisco UCS Manager

options.name: description
options.description: A description of the Server Maintenance Package Policy. Cisco recommends including information about where and when to use the policy. Enter up to 256 characters. You can use any characters or spaces except the following: ` (accent mark),  (backslash), ^ (carat), " (double quote), = (equal sign), > (greater than), < (less than), or ' (single quote).

options.name: hostname
options.description: IP address or hostname of Cisco UCS Manager. Modules can be used with the UCS Platform Emulator U(https://cs.co/ucspe)

options.name: name
options.description: The name assigned to the Server Maintenance Policy. The Server Maintenance Policy name is case sensitive. This name can be between 1 and 16 alphanumeric characters. You cannot use spaces or any special characters other than - (hyphen), "_" (underscore), : (colon), and . (period). You cannot change this name after the Server Maintenance Policy is created.

options.name: password
options.description: Password for Cisco UCS Manager authentication.

options.name: port
options.description: Port number to be used during connection (by default uses 443 for https and 80 for http connection).

options.name: proxy
options.description: If use_proxy is no, specfies proxy to be used for connection. e.g. 'http://proxy.xy.z:8080'

options.name: state
options.description: If C(present), will verify Server Maintenance Policy is present and will create if needed. If C(absent), will verify Server Maintenance Policy is absent and will delete if needed.

options.name: trigger_config
options.description: This option is used in combination with either User Ack (user-ack) or Timer Automatic (timer-automatic). When the On Next Boot option is enabled, the host OS reboot, shutdown, or server reset also triggers the associated FSM to apply the changes. Note that de-selecting the On Next Boot option disables the Maintenance Policy on the BMC.

options.name: uptime_disr
options.description: When a Server profile is associated with a Server, or when changes are made to an associated Server profile, you must reboot the Server. The Reboot Policy field determines when the reboot occurs for Server associated with any Server profiles that include this maintenance policy.

options.name: use_proxy
options.description: If C(no), will not use the proxy as defined by system environment variable.

options.name: use_ssl
options.description: If C(no), an HTTP connection will be used instead of the default HTTPS connection.

options.name: username
options.description: Username for Cisco UCS Manager authentication.
